gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-chivo: Chivo keeps its lowercase tall and its curves open to the light. Nulshock stretches wide with a bold, technical outline, built to make a statement, while Chivo is built to carry the words quietly.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-chocolate-classic: Chocolate Classical Sans writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. Beneath Nulshock's stretched, outlined capitals, Chocolate Classical Sans looks best at a generous size, where that big lowercase can breathe.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-comme: Modern and smooth, this pairing runs bold on top. Nulshock glows like a neon tube with one steady line, and Comme settles beneath it with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-cossette-texte: Clean, wide-eyed lowercase e shapes give Cossette Texte its friendly face under Nulshock's stretched, technical heading. And a longer passage would flow smoothly, since the prominent x-height keeps every line easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-duru-sans: Nulshock bends its strokes like copper pipe, stretched wide and bold across the top of the page. And Duru Sans follows with wide openings on its small letters, so a longer passage would move along cleanly.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-fresca: Stretched, spacious tracking defines Nulshock. Fresca has no calligraphic thinning and keeps its counters connected to the outside, so a longer passage would flow in smooth, modern lines.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-funnel-sans: Nulshock stretches out with spacious tracking and a steady outline, built to look bold and technical in large type. But Funnel Sans does the quieter work, with stroke widths that hold from stem to curve and an e opened wide.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-gafata: Laser-cut and stretched wide, Nulshock cuts its letters with a single width, bold and technical. Gafata then supplies a tall band of lowercase beneath.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-geist: Wide, bold and unmistakably technical. Nulshock stretches across the top, while Geist keeps a quiet, level beat below, so its size is the thing to nudge up if the words feel tight.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-georama: Nulshock stretches its spacious letters wide, with thin joins no thinner than the stems, bold and technical. Georama just reads easily.
